$comment: Typed accumulator contract for team-lead wave sequencing (team-lead/SKILL.md Steps 1-3), and the return contract for the planned team-lead-waves workflow. Field names come from the SKILL.md vocabulary: waves is the Step 1 sequencing plan (sequential outer, parallel inner); sequencing_reasons records WHY tickets were ordered (same-file conflicts, Jira 'Blocks' links, schema-before-API logical ordering); domain is the ticket-swarm domain tag; blocked lists tickets that ended [BLOCKED] so downstream waves and ticket-swarm can react.

waves.$comment: Ordered execution waves. index is the 1-based wave number; tickets are Jira keys; parallel is true when the wave's tickets run concurrently (tickets sharing a file must never share a wave).

sequencing_reasons.$comment: One entry per ordering decision, naming the rule that forced it: same-file merge-conflict risk, a Jira 'Blocks' link, or logical ordering (schema before API, API before frontend, shared libs before consumers).

domain.$comment: The cluster's domain tag as assigned by ticket-swarm triage.

blocked.$comment: Jira keys of tickets that reported a blocker and did not complete. Empty array when every ticket succeeded.
